state:
Goal `tools-php-differences`: 9 of the chapter's 12 features are done. This session added `operators` and `control-flow`. `bun nv proofs --owed --group tools:php-differences` lists the 3 still owed: `what-parses-but-behaves-differently`, `the-tools-you-do-not-install` and `two-spellings-side-by-side`.
So far the proofs have corrected twelve rows of `docs/reference/tools/30-php-differences.md`. This session split the `&` row in § *Operators*: `&` in a parameter or a `foreach` is `E0237`, and `$b = &$a` is `E0701`. Every control-flow row matched the binary.
`int $b = &$a;` (also `var` and a `for` header) was a bare `E0102` parse error. The parser now reports `E0701` there too, through `nvs_syntax::by_reference_assignment`, which the typer's `$b = &$a` refusal now calls. `tests/conformance/lang/a-reference-assignment-in-a-declaration-is-e0701.nvst` pins it.
Gap `nvs-types/a-never-method-that-reaches-its-end-returns`, gap `nvs-syntax/a-second-namespace-statement-in-one-file-compiles` and `nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-concatenates-never-stops` are still open.
Each feature here owes one example, one attack and one case carrying `// covers:`. It owes no `about.md` or bench. `the-tools-you-do-not-install` also owes help: its section shows no code block.
Two `catch` variables of different classes cannot share a name in one scope, even in separate `try` statements (`E0406`), the same as two `foreach` headers.
